title: Tibetan river hosting world’s biggest dam is facing increasing flood risk: study
text:
Tibetan river hosting world’s biggest dam is facing increasing flood risk: study | South China Morning Post Science - Science Tibetan river hosting world’s biggest dam is facing increasing flood risk: study 9 Advertisement Science China Science Tibetan river hosting world’s biggest dam is facing increasing flood risk: study 
 Researchers create a hydrological history using tree rings and data to project future run-off and flood risk in the Yarlung Tsangpo River
 4 -MIN READ 4 -MIN 9 Listen Victoria Bela Published: 10:00am, 26 Oct 2026 Chinese researchers have found that the Yarlung Tsangpo River – soon to host the largest mega dam in the world – may face increased run-off and flood risks over this century. Using tree-ring width chronologies in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau, the team reconstructed the river’s run-off history from 1325 to 2020.
 Along with climate data, this was used to create a model that projected river run-off would increase under future climate scenarios, along with a possible increase in high-run-off events such as floods.
